system.description: Lowers the Control Resistance of the target being or beings.
The ability to channel the flow of Aura or create an Aura storage device.
Allows the practitioner to jump, leap, or spring off of a surface in a controlled manner, or perform maneuvers such as flips and cartwheels.
Allows the practitioner to use a wish-like power to change the fate or destiny of one individual.
The ability to supercharge an item’s powers and abilities, albeit at great risk of a magical mishap or destruction of the item.

Allows the successful practitioner to identify natural animals (living or dead), the habitat the animal can live in, breeding practices, quirks, natural poisons the animal possesses, behavioral traits, and other information that might be useful about the animal. This skill allows for the identification of the following types: Animal, Magical Animal. Creature types are fully explained in the Master’s Manual, Bestiaries like Aspects of the Wild, and Legends of the Unknown of the Unknown.
Allows the caster to mentally connect her consciousness to that of a natural animal.
Allows the user to assume the shape of a choosen natural animal (creature type: animal).
Allows the Practitioner to have anticipated the last action of an opponent, and choose a different action in response.
Causes the target being, or beings to experience disregard for their current situation.
Allows the practitioner to manipulate spatial energies to move objects instantly from one place to another.
The ability to temporarily enchant an arrow with a more potent enchantment. Also, the ability to exercise finer control over a spell that has been previously trapped in an arrow’s aura field.
Allows one being who has a pact with a powerful spell casting patron to finally understand the powers of the patron, and escape the pact to gain those powers for themselves.

Allows one being to make a pact with a patron. The nature of the pact varies depending on conditions the GM determines and may require ritualistic or conditional services from the pact bearer. The pact has to have some form, either a mark or change to the being making the pact, or a physical pact or item held by the patron. The pact grants access to the patron’s magical abilities as shown below. In essence the person making the pact becomes a magic-user who borrows magical ability from the patron.
The ability to apply a ritual much more effectively to a population; alternatively, the ability to apply a ritual to a dramatically larger region.
Allows questions to be asked of plant, and animal life in the area.
The ability to move more freely in heavy, or bulky armor, and be less penalized.
The ability to remove all penalties for wearing heavy, or bulky armor.
Represents the practitioner’s ability to recognize an artifact, and information pertaining to it, from fables and legends. This skill is unlike Identify as is not a magic sense.

Representing the pinnacle of the enchanter’s art, Artificer Lore builds on previously learned skills to produce enhanced effects with the enchanting process. The Artificer Lore practitioner may also attempt certain related skills due to breadth of knowledge of the enchanting process.
Practitioners of this skill can kill one being in one carefully planned attack
The ability to create arrows of pure Aura.
Allows the practitioner to create a channel of pure destructive Aura Fire.
Allows the practitioner to temporarily convert some of their life force to Aura.
This skill provides the practitioner with several forms of automatic protection against various attacks.
Represents the ability to directly manipulate magical energy.
The practitioner performs a sweeping ritual and calls out to the forest to rise up and aid the practitioner, usually to drive out some foe.
Allows the practitioner to give sapience and mobility to a plant.
Allows the practitioner to cause other beings to be in awe, forcing them to behave in a subservient manner.
Allows the successful skill user to balance his center of gravity to walk a tightrope, narrow ledge, etc.
The ability to center one's mind, resulting in better concentration for longer periods of time, and improved senses overall.
Allows the practitioner to write and learn ballads with various magical effects. The skills Sing and Play are used together to perform a memorized ballad.
Allows the practitioner to return a supernatural being to its own plane of existence.
Allows the practitioner to give a war whoop, cry, or scream that unnerves opponents in combat.
Causes the practitioner to appear more beautiful, or handsome than they truly are.
By means of this skill a practitioner can take control of a humanoid, or magical humanoid.
The ability to amplify a target’s voice, allowing it to be heard from farther than normal.
Allows the skill practitioner to enter a state of rage with greater physical abilities.

Allows the successful practitioner to identify certain types of creatures (living or dead), the habitat the creature can live in, its breeding practices, quirks, powers or poisons, behavioral traits, and other useful information about the creature.
Allows the practitioner to bind a being or creature they currently control to a repetitive task, or to guard a general area, externalizing control of that being, or creature.
Allows the practitioner to bind a currently controlled elemental to a repetitive task or to guard a general area, externalizing control of the elemental.
Allows the practitioner to bind a currently controlled physical undead creature (with neither spirit nor soul) to a repetitive task or to guard a general area, externalizing control of the undead.
Allows the practitioner to bind a currently controlled souled undead to a repetitive task or to guard a general area.
Allows the practitioner to bind a currently controlled spiritual undead creature (without a soul) to a repetitive task or to guard a general area, externalizing control of the undead.
Allows the practitioner to bind a currently controlled supernatural being or creature to a repetitive task or to guard a general area, externalizing control of the supernatural being or creature.
Allows a practitioner to bestow the cursing of an evil-aligned deity upon enemies or an object.
The ability to camouflage oneself into natural surroundings.
Allows a practitioner to bestow the blessings of a good-aligned deity upon friends or an object.
Allows the user to go into a frenzied state well beyond the state of the skill Berserking.
Enables the practitioner to enter a meditative trance and then take more direct control of her body and psyche.
Allows the practitioner to use a body area to intercept an incoming thrown or melee weapon.
The ability to take or give magic powers between magical non-living bone objects, and to magically shape non-living bone.
Allows the practitioner to steady himself for improved accuracy and damage in combat.
Allows the practitioner to fall in such a way as to avoid or lessen injury.
Causes all listeners within a certain distance of the skill user to hear a horrendous, discordant mixture of bedlam, and noise; the blackest, and most evil sound imaginable.
Allows the practitioner to summon, and control an Air Elemental from the plane of air.
Allows the practitioner to summon, and control an Aura Elemental from the plane of magic.
Allows the practitioner to summon, and control a Death Elemental from the void.
Allows the practitioner to summon, and control an Earth Elemental from the plane of earth.
Allows the practitioner to summon, and control a Fire Elemental from the plane of fire.
Allows the practitioner to summon, and control a Life Elemental from the plane of light.

The practitioner uses his life force to establish a spiritual portal to higher (and lower) planar realms, sending trapped and lost Spirits and Souls, including ghosts, spiritual, and souled undead, to their intended destinations.
Allows the practitioner to summon, and control a Water Elemental from the plane of water.
The practitioner can attempt to compel all Spirits to come within sensing range of the caster.
Allows the user to create undead beings from the physical remains of the dead or call spirits to rise as undead in an area where one or more deaths have occurred.
Allows the practitioner to use rituals, candle placement, and color to focus spiritual energy and produce a desired result.
Allows an individual to create an accurate, ongoing map of their travels, as well as accurately read existing maps.
Allows the practitioner to charge their hands with a disease, after which touching a living being, transfers all of the disease to the living being.
Represents the ability to manipulate acid, and acidity.
Allows the practitioner to temporarily give or take Will Force from willing beings.
The ability to chant magical rhythms, or to chant beats when combined with Drum.
The practitioner influence over another’s actions and outlook.
The use of this subtle skill allows the practitioner to alter the outcome of a game of chance, either causing themselves or someone else to win or lose.
The practitioner has a mystical awareness of their surroundings that aids in combat situations.
Allows the practitioner to scale a variety of surfaces.
Grants the practitioner immunity to all paralysis, hold, sleep and draining effects of undead creatures controlled by the practitioner.
Allows the practitioner to completely, and irrevocably control a certain number of undead.
Compels the target being to answer truthfully all questions asked by the practitioner.
Causes a target being to be momentarily confused.
The ability to deliver multiple punches in rapid succession but with diminishing returns.
Allows the practitioner to stand unseen in plain sight in any environment.
Allows practitioner control of the growth and age of a living plant, either shrinking or expanding its current size.
Allows the user to control supernatural beings.
Allows the user to control undead beings.
The ability to permanently alter another’s perception.
Allows the practitioner to convert negative life force into positive life force.
The ability to dispel divine magical effects, as well as to disrupt invocations as they’re being invoked.
The ability to dispel magical effects, as well as to disrupt spells as they’re being cast.
The ability to temporarily alter another’s perception.
Hide, alter, or create tracks in a wilderness environment.
Allows the skill practitioner to strike an opponent with melee weapon, applying greater than normal force, doing double damage.
Represents the ability to control and use cold temperatures in various ways.
The ability to take or give powers between magical crystal and ice, and the ability to magically affect crystal, and ice.
Allows the skill practitioner to eliminate disease in one living being.
Allows the skill practitioner to expunge insanity from a being.
Allows the skill practitioner to eliminate the effects of poison within themselves or another being.
Allows the user to negatively affect another being who is an enemy of the practitioner.
Allows the sensing of immediate and impending danger.
The ability to create a magical sphere of darkness.
Creates the illusion of death around oneself, or others.
Allows the practitioner to permanently plant a single, simple lie into another’s mind.
The ability to discover the meaning of words and symbols in code or a language not normally comprehensible to the skill user.
Represents the ability to defy, and strongly resist the effects of divinity through the sheer power of will.
Represents the ability to defy, and strongly resist the effects of magic through the sheer power of will.
Lowers the Magic Resistance of the target being or beings by causing them to believe that they are more susceptible to magic.
Allows the user to sense approximate current depth from the surface, while underground.
The practitioner becomes the master of destiny, altering outcomes wildly.
The ability to utterly destroy an undead creature.
Allows the skill user to focus strong negative energy on their hands and cause death by touch.
The ability to determine a speaker’s alignment.
Allows the user to ascertain and feel the Aura strength of a person, place or thing.
The ability to detect active curses, within sight.
Allows the user to feel the presence of evil beings.
Allows the user to feel the presence of good beings.
Allows the user to see light surrounding Aura based magic (not divine magic).
Allows the user to feel the presence of supernatural beings.
The ability to see activation sites for mechanical traps of either an urban or wilderness nature.
Allows the practitioner to harness magical energy to unleash a powerful concussive force over a large area.
Brings those affected nearer spiritually to the divine, allowing for closer communion between mortals and their gods.
Allows the practitioner to learn in which direction lie north, south, east and west.
Allows the skill user to incapacitate a target being’s limb.
Causes the practitioner to appear to have simply ceased to be.
The ability to divest a target of their weapon.
Causes sounds (including music, speech, and mechanical noise) within earshot of the skill user to sound like discordant, jarring noise.
Represents the ability to permanently remove all magic powers, abilities and effects from a magical item and regain the Will Force used to Enchant or Imbue the item.
The ability to appear to be someone or something else other than themselves.
Allows the user to precisely gauge the distance between two objects, or the distance between herself and the object, thus optimizing missile weapon ranges.
The ability to get an answer from one’s deity (or deity’s minion) about an event or situation that will occur in the future.
Represents a link between the skill practitioner, and a worshiped deity’s hierarchy of minions and supernatural servants. It allows the invoker to pray for new invocations.
Creates a divine protective shell that absorbs ill effects for the practitioner without them being consciously aware the shield has activated.
Creates a divine shield that absorbs all divine and physical effects as long as the practitioner takes no hostile actions.
The ability to contact and speak to supernatural beings (usually belonging to, but not always, of a deity), and to facilitate an auditory connection if so desired.
The ability to maneuver out of the way of a thrown weapon or projectile from a missile weapon.
Allows the practitioner to tap directly into the setting’s purest source of magic and draw it in great volume.

By means of this skill, a practitioner can call an existing dream animal to them within a true dream on the Dream Plane, summon a dream animal to the natural universe for a limited time, or, with great effort, create their own dream animal.
By means of this skill, a practitioner can create or summon a dream object.
This skill can be used for a multitude of purposes around imbuing, enchanting, and disenchanting items on the Dream Plane.
Allows the practitioner to shift from a normal dream to the Dream Plane.
Allows the practitioner to summon a being to or from the Dream Plane while the practitioner is on any plane of existence.
The ability to play a magical percussion instrument, and have its desired effect activated. This skill allows for magical beats to be played when combined with Chant (see Percussion Lore).
Allows the skill user to instantaneously create temporary magical items for their own usage.
Represents the ability to magically manipulate electricity.
The ability to convert the physical damage of an arrow into elemental energy damage.
Provides a basic understanding of the underlying relationship between Aura, the physical world, and its elemental energies, and provides the basis for abilities which manipulate that relationship.
Represents a profound understanding of the physical world and its energies.
The practitioner of this skill is the master of the physical world.
The ability to combine magical ingredients (called Hermetics) to produce a liquid or powder containing magical power. The skill also can be used to identify elixirs upon a successful skill roll.
Causes an aura of holy peace to emanate from the practitioner.
The ability to magically draw another’s hurt into one’s self and cure it.
The ability to perform various magics based on empathy.
The ability to take or give Aura-based magic powers between beings and magical objects.
Represents the ability to permanently enchant a magical item, similar to the spell enchantment in a faster time with additional benefits.
The practitioner’s very presence aboard their vessel causes that vessel to become enchanted.
Represents advanced knowledge of the enchanting process.
The practitioner’s voice becomes a finely tuned magical instrument.
Any weapon becomes a magical weapon in the hands of this practitioner.
Causes the immediate dissolution of subatomic bonds in the area of effect.
Lowers the Poison Resistance of the target being or beings by causing them to believe that they are more susceptible to poison.
This skill allows the user to craft illusions.
Allows the practitioner to dazzle all beings and creatures who hear her speak and gaze upon her.
Causes a decrease in kinetic energy around the practitioner, forcing beings, and objects to move more slowly, or cease motion altogether.
Allows the practitioner to equalize physical harm between any two beings.
Imbues the weapons of the practitioner, and their allies with the power to eradicate the enemies of their god.
The ability to escape confinement.
The ability to evoke the power of an animal within the practitioner’s own body.
Allows the practitioner to cut off another from the practitioner’s deity for a length of time.
Represents an advancement of a mounted archer’s capabilities above and beyond what a mere mortal is normally able to achieve.
The ability to drive out influences, evil or otherwise, within a single individual.
Allows the practitioner to banish all good and evil supernatural in the area of effect.
The ability to make a fake attack in an attempt to lure an opponent into parrying, or losing combat time.

Causes a familiar of a specific type either named by (or required for) the skill user to come to the caster, and bind to them in such a way as to become more than a pet; essentially a magical companion that provides special benefits as outlined below.
Gives the practitioner additional ways to use luck to their advantage. Fate expands on the Luck skill and allows wide-ranging usages.
The ability to cause irrational fear in others.
Allows the practitioner to avoid fear and have a greater chance to avoid control while in combat.
The ability to avoid a melee weapon about to strike the skill user by misdirecting an attacker with body movement.
The ability to appraise the value of goods of various kinds, as well as to make the contacts to sell said goods in a particular known area.
The ability to lead celebrants through the appropriate rituals for a given holiday or significant event. This skill can be considered a sort of magic/divine magic for the masses.
Allows the practitioner to know the location or source of a legend, as well as the general distance and direction, and even the dangers immediately surrounding it.
Allows the practitioner to concentrate and then sense the direction and distance of the nearest treasure trove.
Allows the user to concentrate, and sense the direction and distance of a sought person.
The ability to give or take magical powers between magical non-living flesh, and to shape non-living flesh.
The ability to magically center one’s mind, resulting in better concentration for longer periods of time and an improved connection to mystical and physical energies.
The ability to maximize melee weapon damage.
The ability to push one’s strength beyond its normal limits to produce almost superhuman results.
The ability to see a possible future of oneself.
The ability to see a possible future of another.
The ability to copy artwork, official papers, signatures, or handwriting.
Allows the user to concentrate and see future events of importance.
Gives the user the ability to sense the state of the biosphere as a whole. It also grants the abilities needed to make sweeping changes to the natural world.
The ability to create a permanent dimensional gate connecting any two points or connecting a single point to a network of existing gates.
The ability to create a permanent gateway connecting any two points or add to an existing network.
The ability to cause a mental compulsion in a group of beings to complete a set goal.
Allows the soul of a dying or already-deceased being to be redeemed from the darkness to the light.
Allows the practitioner to create a powerful type of rune called a glyph.
Represents the ability to magically manipulate gravity.
Lowers the Illusion Resistance of the target being, or beings
Causes a covered wagon to become enchanted, offering a variety of magical abilities to those within.
causes dissonant sounds (including music, speech, and mechanical noise) within earshot of the skill user to sound like harmonious and pleasing music.
Allows the practitioner to turn a wooded area into a dangerous demesne.
The divinely granted ability to lay on hands and heal a physical injury.
The ability to identify an herb’s properties, magical or otherwise. It is also the ability to properly use the herb to produce its effects.
Allows the practitioner to use rituals and magical components (Hermetics) to cast spells.
The ability to center one’s body and accomplish superhuman feats of endurance.
Allows for the creation, alteration, and removal of very powerful curses known as hexes.
The ability to handle a trained mount in a precise manner.
The ability to write and learn divine hymns of the skill user’s particular deity, the effects of which are generated with the skill Intone.
The ability to identify the magical powers, abilities or usages on or in a being, area or item. The skill works for items based on Aura and does not extend to divine magic items.
Allows the skill user to understand the powers, special abilities and required method of destruction for a specific artifact.
Provides a basic understanding of how illusions affect one’s mind and how to exploit that relationship for maximum effectiveness.
Represents a deep understanding of the effects that illusions may have on the mind.

The ability to draw effects from alternative sources not already covered by one of the other material and effect manipulation skills (specifically Metal Lore, Wood Lore, Stone Lore, Crystal Lore, Bone Lore, Flesh Lore and Empower) and to then place or enchant those effects into a magic item.
Represents the ability grant temporary magic and enchantments to armor pieces.
Represents the ability grant temporary magic and enchantments to weapons.
Allows the practitioner to intercede with his deity on behalf of another of the deity's followers.
Allows potential energy to be magically transferred to an object.
Magically protects, and can eventually enhance the movement ability of one being.

allows the practitioner to cause beings to become incensed against a particular being, creature or type of either. The type can be a class, group, race or any way to collectively think of a set of beings, or creatures, or a single identifiable individual.
Grants the practitioner unnatural speed.
Allows the practitioner to mark and pursue a foe.
Allows the practitioner to mark and pursue a target being.
Allows the practitioner to confuse, befuddle, anger, and discombobulate all opponents at once.
The ability to influence a non-living being’s actions, and outlook.
Represents the ability to grant temporary powers to the practitioner’s own physical form for 1-3 hours.
The ability to inflict insanity in another.
Allows the practitioner to suffer ill effects on behalf of another being as they occur.
Temporarily prevents a being from receiving any beneficial divine magical effects.
Allows the practitioner to immediately insert themselves between a threat and a being they wish to protect.
Allows the practitioner to suffer adverse physical effects in the target’s stead as those effects occur.
The ability to use training, implied threat, and a steady gaze to overwhelm lesser opponents.
The ability to sing divine hymns.
The practitioner becomes a vision of holy wrath, beautiful and terrible to behold, awing compatriots, and terrifying those who stand against.
The ability to read an item’s past.
The ability to discern type, quality and value of gemstones and precious minerals. Additionally, it provides the ability to correctly cut a gem into its best appearance.
Allows the practitioner to send out a damaging burst of kinetic energy in a desired direction.
This skill provides a basic understanding of the underlying relationship between Aura, the physical world, and its energies, and provides the basis for abilities which manipulate that relationship.
Represents a profound understanding of the physical world and its energies.
A practitioner of this skill is a magical master of the physical world.
Allows the skill user to spend a few moments thinking about a subject and simply know the current information if it is the type of information that would be recorded (history, geography, etc.).

The ability to express ideas and thoughts verbally to a person who does not speak the language(s) of the practitioner, through observation of that language and an understanding of the roots of the languages.
Allows the user to understand and interpret local and regional laws. Also used in a hearing or trial to determine guilt or innocence in the eyes of an authority or jury.
The ability to extend the distance of a jump through acrobatic techniques.
The ability to recall the legends of an event, person, or item.
Causes the target being or beings to move slowly due to a sense of weakness, and tiredness.
The ability to magically adjust the weight of one’s body and thus cause it to rise or slowly drop.
The ability to tell falsehood in a believable fashion.
The ability to sense life the way a snake 'sees' heat.
Allows the practitioner to turn their life force into a positive destroying force or to imbue positive destroying life force into a single weapon.
Allows the creation of a divine magical sphere of illumination.
The ability to learn and cast spells tinged with light energy from the Phase Plane.
The ability to enhance skills, and spells that utilize light, and fire.
A practitioner of this skill is a master of light, and fire.
Allows the practitioner to move from one lit area to another, physically transporting between any two pools of light within visual sight of each other.
The ability to distinguish sounds that are barely audible.
Allows the skill user to turn life force into a positive damaging force or to imbue positive life force into a single weapon.
Gives the skill user a luck reservoir and allows them to change the odds in their favor in various ways. Some of these usages require luck skill points to be used.
Allows the practitioner to change form into pure light, causing flesh and bone to transform into spirit.
Represents the ability to magically manipulate light energy.
Represents the ability to magically manipulate magnetic fields.
Lowers the Disease Resistance of the target being or beings by causing them to believe that they are more susceptible to disease.

Allows the practitioner to always know the location of the target being.  This skill not only provides a distance and direction to the target, but also gives the practitioner knowledge of the target’s exact location.  The practitioner cannot see the target, but rather simply knows where the target is (i.e. the practitioner might use this skill to learn that the target is behind an ale cask and covered in straw in the basement of the Fumbling Foal inn located in the far-away city of Wintersteel which lies 2,479 miles to the southwest of their current location, but they may or may not know of the Fumbling Foal or the city of Wintersteel and does not get a mental image of these places).
The ability to use one’s body as a weapon and for defense.
The Martial Lore skill user is a master of all martial disciplines.
Allows the practitioner to disguise or remove the presence of life force in another, causing it to appear unseen or disguised to skills and effects such as Life Sense or Life Sensing.
Causes a group of targeted beings to fleetingly believe whatever the practitioner is saying.

: Allows the benefits of a ritual to be granted to the population at large during a significant event; conversely, allows a ritual to be made more powerful due to the participation of the people, again during a significant event.
The ability to create a group mind out of willing or conquered sub-minds.
Allows the practitioner to convert one type of matter into another without the required formula.
The ability to settle into a calm state of mind, focusing thoughts and removing anxiety.
Allows the practitioner to dazzle all beings, and creatures who hear the practitioner speak so that they are immediately affected in various ways unless they are able to resist.
The ability to take or give magic powers between metal magical objects and the ability to magically shape metal.
The ability to mimic another’s voice, or mannerisms, as well as the sounds animals, or objects make.
Allows the skill user to mentally attack an opponent more effectively and to blast through mental protections.
The ability to project or read images into and from the mind of another, especially while the focus being is unconscious or in a meditative state.
Allows the skill user to mentally connect to other beings known personally or by name.
Causes a target being to momentarily have a false thought.
Grants expertise in the use of thrown and launched missile weapons.
Targets a specific individual to achieve a desired result, anger, confusion, inaction, befuddlement, etc.
The ability to move without making noise.
The ability to move without being seen.
Allows the skill user to reduce the penalties for multiple missile fire.
Allows the skill user to remove all penalties for multiple missile fire.
Causes all listeners within a certain distance of the skill user to hear a pure, perfect blending of music more exquisite than any mortal could ever attempt to create.
The ability to tell a story so that others are able to witness the events as if they had been there.
The ability to understand nature’s forces, its ecosystems, weather patterns, migrations, eruptions, etc.
Allows the practitioner to provide many divine protections and effects to a selected area.
The ability to chart a course.
Allows the skill user to strike a being numb with pain.
The practitioner exudes an aura of holiness, and all those around him feel it in their hearts.
The ability to call for and interpret divine omens.
The ability to open a lock without its key, without breaking or marring the lock.
Gives knowledge of the revealed leaders, history, practices, ceremonies, and services offered by an Order.
Gives knowledge of hidden aspects of an order, specifically unrevealed leaders, history, practices, ceremonies, and special services of the Order.
Provides various bonuses, information, abilities, etc. for members of a Grand Order.
Allows the practitioner to write and learn magical beats with various magical effects. The skills Chant and Drum are used together to perform a memorized beat.
Allows the skill user to make the perfect shot, doing double damage.
The ability to make oneself physically insubstantial in the natural universe by entering the phase plane.
Allows the skill user to create a permanent disease, and unleash it upon the world.

This skill represents the knowledge of the planar structure of a setting, and the ability to identify various types of supernatural creatures and servants, as well as the home plane of those supernatural beings.
The ability to project oneself divine magically, and others into another dimension.
The ability to project oneself magically, and others into another dimension.
The ability to assume the form of a plant.
The ability to play a magical instrument and have its desired effects activated. This skill also allows for magical ballads to be played when combined with Sing (see Ballad Lore).
The ability to write and learn magical poems, whose effects are released with the skill Recite.
Identification and creation of poisons from recipes.
The ability to mentally take over another’s mind.
The ability to create magical and divine magical potions and formulas for potions, and to identify a potion or interpret another’s potion formula.
Allows the practitioner to mark, and pursue a prey.
The ability to mentally ask a question about the future and receive a yes or no feeling as a reply.
Allows the skill user to move an object instantly from one place to another.
Allows the skill user to extend the medium range of a particular projectile.
Allows the skill user to do extra damage with projectiles.
The ability to create an invisible sphere surrounding the practitioner that protects against evil.
The ability to create an invisible sphere surrounding the practitioner that protects against good.
The skill user can be protected from supernatural beings.

The ability to write, learn, and perform divine psalms dedicated to the skill user’s particular deity with various divine effects. Psalms are combinations of two or more hymns, producing a combined effect. Psalms work in stages, with effects accumulating after the psalmist has spent the appropriate amount of time for each. Thus, if a psalmist combined “Forgiveness” with “Communion”, the effects of “Forgiveness” would occur first (after 15 seconds), and then those of “Communion” (10 seconds later).
Represents the ability to control and use heat and fire in various ways.
The ability to cause a mental compulsion in a set of beings to complete a set goal.
Allows the skill user to draw two projectiles or missile weapons at once and be holding one while firing or throwing another.
Protects the practitioner’s life force, granting greater resistance to effects caused by undead and complete immunity to undead conversion.
Causes missiles to duplicate and strike multiple targets, or strike a target multiple times.
Allows the practitioner to target a large number of corpses and/or skeletal remains and raise an undead horde.
Allows the skill user to rally all friendly troops within sight of the skill user or the skill user’s banners or emblems.
Allows the practitioner to brandish a symbol or banner, and cause all undead who are controlled by either the practitioner, or an ally to be immune to turning, and banishing of any kind.
Allows the practitioner to enter and read the dreams of another being.
The ability to see where a being has been and what happened around them.
The ability to recite poetry that is magical in nature (created with Poem Lore).
The ability to restore life and limb to an individual.
The capability of restoring limbs that were lost or rendered useless through damage.
The ability to redirect the soul of an individual into the body of another being at the time of its birth.

Allows the practitioner to always know the location of the target being. This skill not only provides a distance and direction to the target, but also gives the practitioner knowledge of the target’s exact location. The practitioner cannot see the target, but rather simply knows where the target is (i.e. the practitioner might use this skill to learn that the target is behind an ale cask and covered in straw in the basement of the Fumbling Foal inn located in the far-away city of Wintersteel which lies 2,479 miles to the southwest of their current location, but they may or may not know of the Fumbling Foal or the city of Wintersteel and does not get a mental image of these places).
The ability to remove all curse effects from a target.
The ability to remove all effects of fear in a single being.
The capacity to remove or disarm existing traps, either of an urban or wilderness nature.
The glory of the practitioner’s deity shines round about them, bathing them in the brilliance of their faith.
Allows the practitioner to restore all temporarily missing life force to themselves, or another being.
The ability to restore life to the recently deceased.

Allows the practitioner to continue controlling a target after the normal expiration of whatever effect caused the initial control (such as 1 hour per Practitioner Title through the skill Beguile or 1 minute per Piety Control through the invocation Control Magical Plant), or to prolong the duration a summoned creature must stay with the practitioner (such as 1 day per Aura through the spell Summon or 1 minute per Aura through spells that summon elementals).
The ability to write and learn magical rhythms, the effects of which are generated with the skill Drum or Chant, and to understand the complex rhythms of the natural world.

The paper or surface is placed against the inked type (letters) and a page of the books, leaflets, pamphlets or paper. This is repeated for each copy and then the next page is typeset, inked and produced. In information age cultures the typeset gets replaced with printing plates that are etched (either by hand or with chemicals) and can be used repeatedly to produce the pages.
